protocol: All three scenarios start with the same drone state, measurement-noise settings and random draws, pretrained neural policy, MPPI settings, and zero initial learned correction. All enable dynamics learning and policy adaptation during flight, with no preliminary data collection. Gatekeeper admits controller updates only with an accepted candidate. The changed settings are the hidden drag/bias and whether Gatekeeper is enabled. Each scenario is allowed up to 45 seconds and ends early if a gate is missed or the course clearance is violated. This is a selected example, not a collision-rate estimate or an unconditional safety guarantee. A lap is 3 ordered gates. Clearance is the remaining distance to a course boundary after accounting for the drone's size. A reported gate collision is separately confirmed by overlap between the recorded drone sphere and a gate-frame bar.

outcome.label: Course clearance violated
outcome.basis: Negative recorded clearance; physical gate contact is not established

outcome.label: Contact with Gate 3
outcome.basis: Recorded drone sphere intersects a gate-frame bar
